reviewer.decision_basis: One governed persistent-change Signal is admitted after review of all twelve Live Observations. The selected case has two time-separated primary observations, an explicit comparison baseline, shared-origin limits, materiality rationale, alternatives and falsification conditions. The five machine Signal Candidates are not treated as admission evidence.

candidate_dispositions.rationale: Japan MOF feed history is dominated by one-provider archive and schedule material; it has no governed Observation support for a defined current Signal.
European Council feed history is a one-provider institutional meeting archive, including historical and future schedule metadata rather than a reviewed current change proposition.
The China NBS batch is primarily bootstrap/history material with missing publication times and no established persistence or governed Observation support.

The multi-provider monetary-policy proposal combines unrelated historical publications without one defined baseline, a common proposition or governed supporting Observation set; provider count alone is not corroboration.

The cross-domain convergence proposal aggregates the bootstrap cohort without a bounded proposition, time-separated support or reviewed causal/transmission basis; it remains a review aid, not a governed Signal.

denominator_note: This Signal is a permanent prospective analytical record and remains in the future Signal history unless a governed withdrawal, supersession or expiry decision is recorded. No downstream population or forecast performance claim is created by this admission.
